recommendation: Keep the focused fix. Handle broader availability-status vocabulary, binding strength, or THO migration work under the later ready-to-apply issues rather than expanding FHIR-32557.
issue_request: FHIR-32557 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It clarified that Device.status is about the Device record, removed Device.statusReason, and added Device.availabilityStatus for physical device availability states such as lost, damaged, destroyed, and available.
initial_application: Git commit 0cd35c3c18 applied the R5 change by updating Device.status record wording, removing Device.statusReason, adding Device.availabilityStatus, and creating device availability terminology. That application left two stale descriptions: the Device.availabilityStatus binding said status reason, and the device-availability-status CodeSystem said record status.
additional_context: Device is active and approved in source/fhir.ini, so the edited structure definition and terminology source are in current build scope. Related R5 issues FHIR-36195 and FHIR-36214 refactored operational and association status areas. Later Applied issue FHIR-53243 intentionally re-added unknown to Device.status for R6, so this reconciliation preserved unknown. FHIR-54324 proposes broader future availability terminology changes but is only Resolved - change required, not Applied/Published.
reconciliation: Changed source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml so the Device.availabilityStatus binding describes availability status, and changed source/device/codesystem-device-availability-status.xml so the CodeSystem description describes availability status rather than record status.
source_changes: source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml: corrected Device.availabilityStatus binding description from availability status reason to availability status.
source/device/codesystem-device-availability-status.xml: corrected the device-availability-status CodeSystem description from record status to availability status.
